name: widget-bundle-size
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Is the widget's committed build present and tracker-free, and what does it weigh? widget.js exists; locale chunks exist when non-en locales do; each dist/locales/<code>.js is a flat map of widget.* keys to strings; no listed tracker hostname appears anywhere in dist/. The size of the English page-load set and of each locale chunk is reported on every run and fails nothing (DEC-FBR-IMPL-36). Freshness against src/ is CI job `frontends`.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL with offender detail (file:line); every report prints the tracker-list hash and the sizes. Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

assertion.asserts: A page that embeds the widget downloads no third-party tracker at all, every locale chunk it may fetch is only strings, and whoever changes the widget sees what it now weighs.
assertion.measures: Built artifacts under widget/dist/ only (never source): (trackers) case-insensitive substring scan of every *.{js,mjs,css} file under widget/dist/ RECURSIVELY for any hostname in expected-trackers.txt, whose canonical sorted form is SHA-256-hashed and printed on every run; (chunks) each widget/dist/locales/*.js parsed as `const <id> = {...}; export { <id> as default };` with a JSON object of widget.* keys to string values; (size, reported only) the byte size of TOP-LEVEL widget/dist/*.{js,mjs,css} and of each locale chunk.
known_gaps: Measures the working tree's LAST BUILD, not the source — the caller must build first (npm run build), which is why the freshness triggers list widget/src/** and the CI-parity gate builds before running it.
Size is reported, never judged: a large increase passes. It is visible in every check's output, and the person landing the change is expected to read it (DEC-FBR-IMPL-36).

The tracker scan matches hostnames as case-folded substrings, so a tracker reached via an IP address, a CNAME alias, or a runtime-assembled string would not be seen. The a11y e2e run (real network requests visible to Playwright) is the second leg.
The chunk-shape check reads the build output's literal form; if the bundler changes how it emits a constant object, the check fails loudly rather than passing, and the parser here needs updating.

consumer_scope: P2+ widget/ (every commit touching widget/dist/, widget/src/ or i18n/locales/*/widget.json; CI gate from P2 start)
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/widget-bundle-size/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.authored_by: CLAUDE-A worker (P2 Customer-Facing, Task Zero — collab-20260514-035703)
provenance.rationale: FR-FBR-04 (lightweight widget) + DEC-FBR-02 (no third-party trackers brand promise). The 30 KiB cap (raised to 40 KiB by DEC-FBR-IMPL-35) was removed by DEC-FBR-IMPL-36 on the owner's word: it entered as one cell of a scope table with no stated reason, and size is now reported rather than capped. The per-chunk 4 KiB cap was a proxy for 'a chunk is only strings' and is replaced by a direct check of that.
